environment.description: Same service deployed behind an nginx-based ingress controller (ingress-nginx v1.9.4) with mutual TLS verification configured at the ingress annotation level. The ingress resource specifies nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client: 'on' with auth-tls-secret pointing to a CA bundle that only contains the organization's internal PKI intermediate CA. Additionally, the ingress has nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-depth: '2' and nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-error-page: 'https://errors.internal/mtls-required'. The upstream proxy_pass to the service pod only occurs after successful client certificate validation. A Cilium NetworkPolicy restricts pod-to-pod traffic such that only the ingress controller pods (label: app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx) can reach the application pods on port 8080. External traffic must traverse the ingress path.

config.network_policy: Cilium L4 policy: only ingress-nginx pods -> app pods:8080
config.ca_bundle: Organization internal PKI intermediate CA only (no public CAs)
